hero.title: Terms and conditions
hero.lead: The framework applicable to the consulting, audit, security testing, secure development and compliance support services provided by Smidjan.

cgv.intro: These terms and conditions govern the services provided by Smidjan. They do not replace the quotation or the contract signed for a given engagement, which prevails in the event of any contradiction.

objet.title: Purpose
objet.body: These terms and conditions govern the consulting, audit, security testing, secure development and compliance support (NIS2 / CyberFundamentals) services provided by Smidjan to its professional clients.

devis.title: Quotation and order
devis.body: Every service is the subject of a prior quotation detailing the scope, the deliverables, the indicative schedule and the price. The service is deemed accepted upon signature of the quotation, upon its written confirmation (including by e-mail), or upon payment of any deposit.

execution.title: Performance of the services
execution.p1: Smidjan undertakes to perform the services diligently, in accordance with the professional standards of the trade and the applicable frameworks (in particular OWASP, ISO/IEC 27001, CyberFundamentals). The communicated timeframes are given for indicative purposes only, unless an explicit contrary commitment is made in the quotation.
execution.p2: Prices are set in euros, exclusive or inclusive of all taxes as indicated in the quotation. The invoicing terms (any deposit, due dates and milestones) are specified in the quotation specific to each engagement, which the client accepts upon signature or upon validation by e-mail. Any sum not paid by its due date may give rise, after a formal notice that has remained without effect, to the interest and compensation provided for by the Belgian Act of 2 August 2002 on combating late payment in commercial transactions, where it applies.

responsabilite.title: Liability
responsabilite.body: Smidjan's liability may only be engaged in the event of a proven fault in the performance of its services. It is limited to direct and foreseeable damage and, except in the event of gross or intentional fault, capped at the total amount invoiced for the engagement concerned. Smidjan cannot be held liable for the consequences of a vulnerability not detected during an audit or a security test, as these services constitute an obligation of means and not of result.

confidentialite.title: Confidentiality
confidentialite.p1: Each party undertakes to keep strictly confidential the technical, commercial or organisational information exchanged in the context of the engagement, throughout its duration and after its end, unless otherwise agreed in writing or subject to a legal obligation of disclosure.
confidentialite.p2: The personal data processed on this occasion is processed in accordance with our <link>privacy policy</link>.

propriete.title: Intellectual property of the deliverables
propriete.body: Unless otherwise stipulated in the quotation, the reports, analyses and recommendations delivered to the client are granted to it for use for its internal needs. The methodologies, tools and templates specific to Smidjan remain its property. For custom development services, the scope of the transfer of rights to the delivered code is specified in the corresponding quotation.

resiliation.title: Termination
resiliation.body: In the event of a serious breach by one party of its obligations, not remedied within a reasonable time after a written formal notice, the other party may terminate the ongoing engagement, without prejudice to the sums already due for the work carried out.

droit.title: Applicable law and competent jurisdiction
droit.body: These terms and conditions are governed by Belgian law. Any dispute relating to their validity, their interpretation or their performance falls within the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the judicial district of Liège, subject to the mandatory provisions applicable in matters of consumer protection.
droit.callout: This document is a template: it must be adapted to each engagement and validated by a lawyer before any contractual use. In the event of any contradiction, the quotation or contract signed by both parties always prevails over this generic outline.

hero.title: Privacy policy (GDPR)
hero.lead: What we collect via the contact form, why, for how long, with whom, and an honest answer about the cookies and third-party services used.

conf.intro: Smidjan attaches importance to the protection of the personal data of the website's visitors and clients, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of 27 April 2016 ("GDPR") and the Belgian Act of 30 July 2018 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.

responsable.title: Data controller
responsable.body: The controller of the data collected via this website is Smidjan, Wallonia, Belgium: <link>jeanbaptiste.dhondt1@gmail.com</link>.

donnees.title: Data collected
donnees.formulaire: Contact form / diagnosis request: surname, first name, company (optional), e-mail address, telephone number (optional), content of the message.
donnees.navigation: Browsing data: IP address, browser and device type, pages viewed, collected for security purposes and, where applicable, for audience measurement.
donnees.recaptcha: Data from Google reCAPTCHA: technical signals used to distinguish a human user from a robot when submitting the contact form.

finalites.title: Purposes of the processing
finalites.item1: Respond to requests for contact, quotation or free diagnosis;
finalites.item2: Ensure the security and integrity of the contact form (anti-spam and anti-robot protection);
finalites.item3: Measure and improve the use of the website, where applicable, by means of statistical tools.

baseLegale.title: Legal basis
baseLegale.item1: The performance of pre-contractual measures taken at the request of the data subject, for the handling of contact requests;
baseLegale.item2: The legitimate interest of Smidjan in securing its form and its website against abuse (reCAPTCHA);
baseLegale.item3: The consent of the user, where it is required for non-essential audience measurement cookies.

duree.title: Retention period
duree.body: The data submitted via the contact form is kept for a period of 3 years from the last exchange, unless a longer legal retention obligation applies (in particular accounting) or an ongoing contractual relationship exists.

destinataires.title: Recipients of the data
destinataires.body: The data is processed by Smidjan's authorised staff and, where applicable, by its technical subprocessors (hosting, e-mail, anti-spam and audience measurement tools). It is neither sold, nor rented, nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.

cookies.title: Cookies & third-party services
cookies.p1: This website is not free of cookies or trackers: we do not claim to operate "without any cookie". The following categories may be used:

row1.base: Legitimate interest / necessary for the service

row2.finalite: Protection of the contact form against robots and abuse

cookies.p2: To date, the website uses no audience measurement (analytics) tool nor any advertising cookie. If such a tool were to be put in place, this policy would be updated accordingly.
cookies.p3: Some of these services, in particular Google reCAPTCHA, are provided by third parties established outside the European Union (United States) and may involve a corresponding transfer of data. These transfers rely on the safeguards provided for by the GDPR, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. You may at any time configure your browser to block or delete non-essential cookies; this may however limit certain features of the website (for example the submission of the contact form).

droits.title: Your rights
droits.p1: In accordance with Articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the following rights over your data: the right of access, of rectification, of erasure, of restriction of processing, of portability, of objection, as well as the right to withdraw your consent at any time where the processing depends on it.
droits.p2: To exercise these rights, contact us at <link>jeanbaptiste.dhondt1@gmail.com</link>. A reply will be provided within the timeframes laid down by the GDPR.
droits.p3: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian supervisory authority: Data Protection Authority (DPA), Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels: www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be.

dpo.title: Data protection officer contact
dpo.body: Given its size and the nature of its processing activities, Smidjan has not appointed a formal data protection officer (DPO), as this appointment is not mandatory in its case. Any question relating to the processing of your data may be sent to <link>jeanbaptiste.dhondt1@gmail.com</link>.
